tools.name: connect_crm

Do not use when: the user only wants to see which CRMs are supported or check their connection status (use get_supported_integrations), or wants to export records (use the CRM export tools).

Returns: redirectUrl to open in the browser to complete OAuth.
Credits: does not consume credits.
